---
params:
  x:          NULL
  tab_title:  ""
  type:       "age"
  meta:       !r NULL
  collective: !r NULL
  ytables_used: !r NULL
title: '`r { .b <- if (identical(params$type, "dq")) "Zuwachs nach Mitteldurchmesserklassen" else "Zuwachs nach Altersklassen"; .s <- if (!is.null(params$meta$inv_year_prev)) " -- Wiederholungsinventur" else if (identical(params$meta$source, "gnfi3")) " -- Sch\u00e4tzung nach BWI 3" else if (identical(params$meta$source, "ytable")) " -- Ertragstafelsch\u00e4tzung" else ""; paste0("\\fontsize{14}{16}\\selectfont ", .b, .s) }`'
date: ""
classoption:
  - a4paper
geometry:
  - portrait
  - "left=0.7cm,right=0.7cm,top=1cm,bottom=1.2cm"
fontsize: 10pt
header-includes:
  # The table LaTeX is emitted via cat() from an asis chunk (to post-process
  # the page-break behaviour), so knitr does not auto-load the kableExtra table
  # packages -- declare them here.
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \usepackage{array}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Escape the LaTeX specials that may occur in user-supplied strings
# (Forstbetrieb name, custom collective definition).
latex_escape <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(x)
  x <- as.character(x)
  gsub("([&%$#_])", "\\\\\\1", x)
}

# Prevent page breaks WITHIN a species block of a kableExtra longtable. Each
# pack_rows group starts with a line "\addlinespace[0.3em]". A longtable row
# ending in "\\" allows a break after it, "\\*" forbids it. We turn every
# breakable terminator into "\\*", except the row right before the next group
# boundary (so breaks still happen between species blocks). Blocks are small
# (a handful of rows), so they never exceed a page.
no_break_within_groups <- function(tex) {
  lines <- strsplit(tex, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  is_boundary <- trimws(lines) == "\\addlinespace[0.3em]"
  n <- length(lines)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ln <- lines[i]
    if (endsWith(ln, "\\\\") && !endsWith(ln, "\\\\*")) {
      j <- i + 1L
      while (j <= n && trimws(lines[j]) == "") j <- j + 1L
      next_boundary <- j <= n && is_boundary[j]
      next_end      <- j <= n && grepl("end{longtable}", lines[j], fixed = TRUE)
      if (!next_boundary && !next_end) lines[i] <- paste0(ln, "*")
    }
  }
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}
```

```{r header-block, results = "asis"}
m  <- params$meta
co <- params$collective

# Forstbetrieb name (= tab_title) prominent, centred right below the title --
# same header style as the "Zuwachs auf Betriebsebene" overview PDFs.
if (!is.null(params$tab_title) && nzchar(params$tab_title)) {
  cat("\\vspace{-3em}\\begin{center}\n",
      "{\\large\\textbf{", latex_escape(params$tab_title), "}}\n",
      "\\end{center}\n", sep = "")
}

# Collective label, centred just below the name -- same as the gnfi3 and
# yield-table overview PDFs: only the label ("Hauptbestand" / "Alle Schichten"
# / custom), no "Kollektiv:" prefix.
if (!is.null(co$label)) {
  cat("\\begin{center}\\small ", latex_escape(co$label),
      "\\end{center}\\vspace{-0.3em}\n", sep = "")
}

# Meta block, flushleft -- the same block as the "Zuwachs auf Betriebsebene"
# overview PDF. This template uses narrow page margins (0.7 cm) for the wide
# class table, so every line is indented by 0.8 cm to sit at the same absolute
# position as the overview PDF's meta block (1.5 cm margin). Blocks are joined
# with "\\" so no dangling line break precedes \end{flushleft}. For a repeated
# inventory (inv_year_prev present) the two survey years share a small tabular;
# for a single-inventory increment only the Inventur line is shown.
indent <- "\\hspace*{0.8cm}"
fmt_ha <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",",
                             scientific = FALSE)
blocks <- character(0)

if (!is.null(m)) {
  # Split available only when second-only plots were folded in (combined path).
  has_split <- !is.null(m$n_plots_repeated) && !is.null(m$n_plots_backward)
  # Tail of the current-inventory line: area and point count.
  tail_parts <- character(0)
  if (!is.null(m$area_ha)) tail_parts <- c(tail_parts,
    paste0("\\textbf{Gesamtfl\\\"ache:} ", fmt_ha(m$area_ha), " ha"))
  if (!is.null(m$n_plots)) tail_parts <- c(tail_parts,
    paste0("\\textbf{Inventurpunkte:} ", as.integer(m$n_plots)))
  tail_str <- paste(tail_parts, collapse = "\\hspace{1.5em}")

  if (!is.null(m$inv_year_prev)) {
    blocks <- c(blocks, sprintf(paste0(
      "\\begin{tabular}{@{}l@{ }r@{}l}\n",
      "\\textbf{Inventur:} & %d & \\hspace{2em}%s \\\\\n",
      "\\textbf{Vorhergehende Inventur:} & %d & \\\\\n",
      "\\end{tabular}"),
      as.integer(m$year), tail_str, as.integer(m$inv_year_prev)))
  } else if (!is.null(m$year)) {
    line <- paste0("\\textbf{Inventur:} ", as.integer(m$year))
    if (nzchar(tail_str)) line <- paste0(line, "\\hspace{1.5em}", tail_str)
    blocks <- c(blocks, line)
  }

  if (!is.null(m$period_yr))
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Periode:} ", as.integer(m$period_yr),
                               " Jahre"))
  if (!is.null(m$method))
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Berechnungsmethode:} ",
                               latex_escape(m$method)))
  if (!is.null(m$fill_option))
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Erg\\\"anzungsmethode:} ",
                               latex_escape(m$fill_option)))
  # Compact point-count composition at the bottom of the meta block (only
  # when second-only plots were folded in): repeatedly measured vs. newly
  # established (BWI-3-backward-estimated) points.
  if (has_split) {
    fmt_n <- function(x) format(as.integer(x), big.mark = ".",
                                scientific = FALSE)
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0(
      "\\textbf{Wiederholt gemessene Punkte:} ", fmt_n(m$n_plots_repeated),
      "; \\textbf{neu erfasste Punkte:} ", fmt_n(m$n_plots_backward),
      " (BWI 3-Zuwachssch\\\"atzung)"))
  }
}

cat("\\begin{flushleft}\n")
if (length(blocks) > 0)
  cat(indent, paste(blocks, collapse = paste0("\\\\\n", indent)), "\n", sep = "")
cat("\\end{flushleft}\n")
```

```{r build-table, results = "asis"}
oo <- options(knitr.kable.NA = "", fe_spec_lang = "ger")
x  <- params$x

# Numeric columns: the class levels (labels start with "(") plus the summary
# column "total".
class_cols <- names(x)[substr(names(x), 1, 1) == "("]
num_cols   <- names(x)[vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))]

# 1. Drop the display-only tree-count rows (n Bäume / n gnfi3).
x <- dplyr::filter(x, !.data$variable %in% c("n_iv_total", "n_iv_filled"))

# 2. Format numbers to strings (German): integer for the point count, one
#    decimal otherwise. Done before the CI merge so all cells are character.
is_int <- x$variable == "n_plot_class"
fmt_cell <- function(v, intg) dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(v) ~ NA_character_,
  intg     ~ formatC(as.integer(round(v)), format = "d", big.mark = "."),
  TRUE     ~ formatC(round(v, 1), format = "f", digits = 1,
                     big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
)
for (cn in num_cols) x[[cn]] <- fmt_cell(x[[cn]], is_int)

# 3. Merge the 95% CI into the TOTAL cell of the increment-sum and per-ha rows
#    ("value ± ci"), then drop the standalone CI rows. Per-class cells stay
#    value-only (the CI is shown only on the aggregated totals).
x$total_ci <- NA_character_
grp <- ifelse(is.na(x$species_group), "SUM", format(x$species_group))
attach_ci_total <- function(dat, val_var, ci_var) {
  ci_by_grp <- stats::setNames(dat$total[dat$variable == ci_var],
                               grp[dat$variable == ci_var])
  rows <- which(dat$variable == val_var)
  for (i in rows) {
    ci <- ci_by_grp[[grp[i]]]
    if (!is.na(dat$total[i]) && !is.null(ci) && !is.na(ci))
      dat$total_ci[i] <- paste0("± ", ci)
  }
  dat
}
x <- attach_ci_total(x, "iv_m3_yr_total", "ci95_iv_m3_yr_total")
x <- attach_ci_total(x, "iv_m3_ha_yr",    "ci95_iv_m3_ha_yr")
x <- dplyr::filter(x, !.data$variable %in%
                     c("ci95_iv_m3_yr_total", "ci95_iv_m3_ha_yr"))

# 4. Row labels. Ideal-area rows carry a superscript footnote reference (¹);
#    the per-ha ideal-area value has no CI.
x <- dplyr::mutate(x, variable = dplyr::recode(.data$variable,
  n_plot_class     = "Anz. Pkte.",
  site_index       = "Ertragskl. (mittl.)",
  iv_m3_yr_total   = "zv (m³/J)",
  iv_m3_ha_yr      = "zv (m³/ha/J)",
  area_ha          = "Fl. (ha) ideell¹",
  iv_m3_ha_yr_virt = "zv (m³/ha/J) ideell¹"
))

# 5. Vertical grouping by species; cross-species block (NA) at the bottom.
vertical_index_dat <- x |>
  dplyr::group_by(species_group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(is.na(species_group), species_group)
vertical_index <- vertical_index_dat$n
grp_names <- format(vertical_index_dat$species_group)
grp_names[is.na(vertical_index_dat$species_group)] <- "Total"
names(vertical_index) <- grp_names

# 6. Drop species_group; the variable column becomes the (blank-headed) label.
x <- x |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-.data$species_group) |>
  dplyr::rename("Größe" = "variable")

# 7. Horizontal grouping header over the class columns.
horizontal_index <- c(1, length(class_cols), 2)
names(horizontal_index) <- if (identical(params$type, "age"))
  c(" ", "Altersklassen (Jahre)", " ") else c(" ", "dg-Klassen (cm)", " ")

# 8. Render. The first column header ("Größe") is blanked. The generated
#    LaTeX is post-processed so species blocks are not split across pages.
cn <- names(x)[-1]
cn[length(cn)] <- " "   # blank the header over the ± (total_ci) column
kbl <- knitr::kable(x, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE,
             escape = TRUE, col.names = c(" ", cn),
             align = c("l", rep("r", length(class_cols) + 1L), "l")) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(horizontal_index) |>
  kableExtra::pack_rows(index = vertical_index,
                        hline_after = FALSE, hline_before = TRUE) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 8,
                            latex_options = c("repeat_header"))

tex <- no_break_within_groups(as.character(kbl))
# Tighten the gap between the Total value column and the ± (total_ci) column.
repl <- "r@{\\hspace{5pt}}l}"
pos  <- regexpr("rl}", tex, fixed = TRUE)
if (pos > 0L)
  tex <- paste0(substr(tex, 1L, pos - 1L), repl, substr(tex, pos + 3L, nchar(tex)))
cat(tex)

options(oo)
```

```{r ytables-used, results = "asis"}
# Yield-table class tables carry the list of used yield tables; print it one
# per line (Baumart label only on the first line of each group). NULL for the
# repeated-survey / gnfi3 tables -> nothing printed.
yt <- params$ytables_used
if (!is.null(yt) && nrow(yt) > 0) {
  oo2 <- options(fe_spec_lang = "ger")
  t2 <- yt |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$species_group) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      .lab = ifelse(dplyr::row_number() == 1L,
                    format(.data$species_group), "")
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::transmute(`Baumart/Artgruppe` = .data$.lab,
                     Ertragstafel = .data$name_orig)
  cat("\\vspace{1em}\n\\noindent\\textbf{Verwendete Ertragstafeln}",
      "\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n", sep = "")
  print(
    knitr::kable(t2, booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, linesep = "", align = c("l", "l")) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"),
                                full_width = FALSE)
  )
  options(oo2)
}
```

```{r footnote, results = "asis"}
co <- params$collective
m  <- params$meta
cat("\\begin{flushleft}\\vspace{0.5em}\\small\\itshape\n")

# 1. Volume unit.
cat("Alle Volumenangaben verstehen sich als Erntefestmeter ohne Rinde ",
    "(Efm o.R.).\n", sep = "")
cat("\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")

# 2. The increment includes trees removed between the two inventories.
if (is.null(m$source)) {
cat("Der ausgewiesene Zuwachs schlie\\ss{}t den Zuwachs der zwischen den beiden ",
    "Inventuren ausgeschiedenen B\\\"aume mit ein.\n", sep = "")
cat("\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")
}

# 3. The per-ha increment refers to the whole operation area.
if (identical(co$kind, "main_stand")) {
cat("Die hektarbezogenen Werte in der Zeile \"zv (m\\textsuperscript{3}/ha/J)\" ",
    "beziehen sich auf die gesamte Betriebsfl\\\"ache; zu ihr z\\\"ahlen auch ",
    "Inventurpunkte, die im gew\\\"ahlten Kollektiv keine B\\\"aume enthalten. ",
    "Die Werte in der Zeile \"zv (m\\textsuperscript{3}/ha/J) ideell\" beziehen ",
    "sich dagegen auf die ideelle Reinbestandsfl\\\"ache der jeweiligen Baumart.\n",
    sep = "")
} else {
cat("Die hektarbezogenen Werte (\"zv (m\\textsuperscript{3}/ha/J)\") beziehen ",
    "sich auf die gesamte Betriebsfl\\\"ache; zu ihr z\\\"ahlen auch ",
    "Inventurpunkte, die im gew\\\"ahlten Kollektiv keine B\\\"aume enthalten.\n",
    sep = "")
}
cat("\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")

# 4. Collective-specific note.
if (identical(co$kind, "main_stand")) {
  cat("¹~Die Berechnung ideeller Anteilsfl\\\"achen ist aus methodischer ",
      "Sicht problematisch; darauf bezogene Zuwachswerte sind stets mit Vorsicht ",
      "zu interpretieren. ",
      if (is.null(m$source)) paste0(
        "Ber\\\"ucksichtigt sind die Standfl\\\"achen aller ",
      "B\\\"aume des Kollektivs, auch der zwischen den Inventuren ausgeschiedenen. ") else "",
      "Bei starken Verschiebungen der Baumartenanteile (z.\\,B. durch ",
      "Extremereignisse) k\\\"onnen fl\\\"achenbezogene Zuw\\\"achse resultieren, ",
      "die biologisch stark unplausibel, aber rechnerisch richtig sind. ",
      "Hektarbezogene Zuw\\\"achse, die sich auf die gesamte Betriebsfl\\\"ache ",
      "beziehen, sind von diesem m\\\"oglichen Problem nicht betroffen.\n",
      sep = "")
} else {
  cat("F\\\"ur dieses Kollektiv werden keine ideellen Baumarten-Anteilsfl\\\"achen ",
      "und keine darauf bezogenen Zuw\\\"achse ausgewiesen -- das ist nur f\\\"ur ",
      "den Hauptbestand m\\\"oglich.\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")

# 5. CI meaning + optimism note.
if (is.null(m$source)) {
cat("Mit \\ensuremath{\\pm} ist die Halbweite des 95\\,\\%-Konfidenzintervalls ",
    "des jeweiligen Gesamt-Zuwachswertes angegeben (nur in der Spalte ",
    "\"Total\"). Da in den Zuwachs sowohl wiederholt gemessene als auch mit den ",
    "Zuwachsfunktionen der 3.~Bundeswaldinventur (BWI~3) gesch\\\"atzte Punkte ",
    "und B\\\"aume eingehen, ist er als eher optimistische Sch\\\"atzung des ",
    "Vertrauensbereichs zu verstehen.\n", sep = "")
}

# 6. rep_classic note (only when that calculation method was used).
if (!is.null(m$method) && identical(m$method, "rep_classic")) {
  cat("\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")
  cat("Bei der Berechnungsmethode \"rep\\_classic\" k\\\"onnen in Einzelf\\\"allen ",
      "negative Zuw\\\"achse auftreten. Das ist statistisch korrekt.\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\\end{flushleft}\n")
```
